name: Cold storage

subjectOf.text: Cold storage custody solutions are much more secure and resistant to cyber attacks than hot storage because the digital assets and associated private keys are held in wallets that are not connected to the Internet.
subjectOf.abstract: Because of these distinguishing features, cold storage has several key benefits. For one, cold storage custody solutions are much more secure and resistant to cyber attacks.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876

subjectOf.text: Cold storage trades security for accessibility: retrieving digital assets from cold storage can take many hours or even days, which makes cold storage especially ill suited to dynamic trading strategies.
subjectOf.abstract: In some cases, it can take many hours or even days for investors to obtain control of digital assets that are stored in cold storage devices. The timing makes it especially difficult to use cold storage security for dynamic trading strategies.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: assets held in cold storage devices
matters most for actively traded positions

subjectOf.text: Cold wallets typically lack the multisig feature that is common in hot storage, so the single employee acting as agent for a corporation may be the only access point to the corporate digital assets.
subjectOf.abstract: Accordingly, the person who acts as an agent to a corporation who holds the assets on behalf of the company may be the only access point to the corporate assets.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
scope_conditions: corporate or treasury holdings in cold storage without multisig

subjectOf.text: Multi-signature wallets and a combination of hot and cold storage solutions are the advisable custody design for digital assets.
subjectOf.abstract: Multi-signature wallets and a combination of hot and cold storage solutions are advisable.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hayley Howe, Custody of Digital Assets (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3936876
